shortBio: Jeanine Emilia Cornillot is an Emmy and Ambie-winning showrunner and executive producer who has made more than 300 episodes of television and podcasts. She created and showran Scamfluencers and The Last City, co-developed and produced Dying for Sex, and was a supervising producer on the Emmy-winning Born This Way. She is also the author of Family Sentence and the founder of Ghost Mode Labs, where she develops original IP and prototypes new ways to use AI and other emerging technologies to research, develop, and extend stories.

fullBio: Jeanine Emilia Cornillot is an Emmy and Ambie-winning showrunner and executive producer who has made more than 300 episodes of television and podcasts. Her work ranges from unscripted television and narrative nonfiction to true crime and original audio fiction.

She created and showran Scamfluencers and The Last City and co-developed and produced Dying for Sex, all for Wondery and Amazon. Her television credits include A&E's Born This Way, which won three Primetime Emmys, and Vox Media and PBS's No Passport Required, a James Beard Media Award winner.
Cornillot is also the author of Family Sentence, a funny and unsentimental memoir of a Cuban American girlhood lived between cultures and in the shadow of a father's incarceration.

At Wondery, she founded the company's first AI Creator Lab and grew participation from four people to more than fifty across the company. Through Ghost Mode Labs, she now develops original IP and prototypes new ways to use AI and other emerging technologies in story research, development, and extension.

portfolioChapters.title: Productions
portfolioChapters.description: Television and podcasts, including unscripted series, narrative nonfiction, true crime, and original audio fiction.

items.title: Scamfluencers
items.summary: A weekly true-crime series about the internet's most audacious scammers and the people caught in their stories.
items.proof: The series has 53 million downloads, reached number one on Apple Podcasts, and won the 2023 Ambie for Best Entertainment Podcast, with a second nomination in 2025.

items.title: Dying for Sex
items.role: Co-developer and producer of the original podcast
items.summary: A narrative series about Molly Kochan leaving her marriage after a terminal cancer diagnosis and telling the story to her best friend, Nikki Boyer.
items.proof: The original podcast won the 2021 Ambie for Podcast of the Year. Its FX television adaptation won a Peabody Award, received nine Emmy nominations, and received a 2026 Television Academy Honor.

items.title: The Last City
items.summary: An immersive 12-part science-fiction thriller starring Rhea Seehorn, set inside a utopian society surviving the climate crisis and designed natively in Dolby Atmos.
items.proof: Wondery's first original series designed natively in Dolby Atmos, with sound shaping the story from the pitch and writers' room onward. It reached number one in Apple Fiction in 20 countries and was nominated for the 2025 Ambie for Best Fiction Podcast.

items.title: Born This Way
items.summary: A documentary series following seven young adults with Down syndrome as they build careers, independence, and relationships.
items.proof: The series won three Primetime Emmys and received 16 nominations.

items.title: No Passport Required
items.organization: Vox Media, PBS, and Apple TV
items.summary: Chef Marcus Samuelsson travels the United States to explore immigrant communities redefining American food.
items.proof: The series won a James Beard Media Award.

items.title: Hollywood & Crime
items.summary: Two seasons inside Wondery's Hollywood true-crime anthology, including Billionaire Boys Club and The Execution of Bonny Lee Bakley.

items.title: Life of Kylie
items.summary: A documentary series following Kylie Jenner at the height of the Kardashian-Jenner media empire.

portfolioChapters.title: Ghost Mode Labs
portfolioChapters.description: Ghost Mode Labs is where Jeanine develops original IP and prototypes new ways to use AI and other emerging technologies in story research, worldbuilding, visual audio, and new formats.

items.title: Visual Audiobooks
items.summary: Original children's stories that redraw their visual world each time a listener returns.

items.title: Static
items.summary: A scripted supernatural series built from online folklore, developed with a research tool that finds recurring story patterns across public archives.

items.title: Multiverse Quad
items.summary: One story retold as an animated film, graphic novel, visual audiobook, and podcast.

items.title: AI Creator Lab
items.summary: A hands-on Wondery program where creative teams tested emerging tools inside real production work. Participation grew from four people to more than fifty across the company.

items.title: Narrative Space
items.summary: A working prototype that turns story notes, characters, timelines, and locations into a three-dimensional space writers can explore.

items.title: Unstill
items.summary: An archival storytelling experiment using records, color, motion, and changing inscriptions to reconsider lives preserved in 1920s Sydney police photographs.

items.title: MythOS
items.summary: A research tool connecting 3,500 years of mythology and folklore across cultures, built to help development teams find public-domain story material.
items.proof: The working prototype contains 494 source stories.
